criteria.description: The artifact remains a concise, creator-reviewable 60-second concept PV design. It does not silently change runtime or format, expand into a source audit or production handbook, or collapse the requested design into one technical validation.
One coherent concept and a causal six-to-eight-beat experience spine use specific Rain Station evidence including Mara, 23:47, the red umbrella and the unlit train without inventing story facts.

Visual, action, sound, text and pacing choices materially shape the beats and are specific enough for a creator, storyboard artist or generation prompt author to continue from; generic aesthetic adjectives and repeated source summary do not substitute for decisions.

The concise artifact has only two functional blocks: one concept paragraph plus at most four true cross-shot invariants and no evidence inventory; then one authoritative six-to-eight-beat causal sequence owning timing, image, action, sound and transitions. Nested headings or bold field groups do not recreate core-analysis, source-binding, key-shot, visual, sound, production, technology, acceptance, or creator-question mini-sections.

The formal document excludes source-reading narration, Tool logs, work progress, internal checks and rejected reasoning. Evidence limitations appear only where they constrain a claim or creator decision, and no section can be removed without losing creative or production value.

Media-production exposes only the stable creative decisions, source or shot references and continuity requirements needed by a later capability. It does not append generation prompts, operation or parameter names, acceptance packets, production stages, or a cross-Skill workflow.
